## 一分钟读懂
### 1. Silero‑VAD 在系统中的位置
<whiteboard token="CatZwRAUChYzyzbzumgcMvtfnOe" align="left"/>

**结论**：VAD 是下游语音系统的门控层；它回答“何时有语音”，不回答“说了什么”或“谁在说”。
### 2. 从声音到语音片段是两层处理
<whiteboard token="OkVwwPX6ghRkWSbLZEbcaybhnXg" align="left"/>

**结论**：模型只输出每块概率；`get_speech_timestamps` 才把概率序列变成可用的时间段。
### 3. 分段规则如何避免频繁开关
<whiteboard token="Tkf2wHW6MhG9BFbGpZGcyRH0n1b" align="left"/>

**结论**：默认进入阈值为 0.5，退出阈值为 0.35；两个阈值之间的迟滞区让短暂波动不会立刻结束语音。

**官方事实**：采样率或批大小 `B` 改变时，ONNX 封装会自动重置循环状态和波形上下文；新流开始时也应显式调用 `reset_states()`。[2]
**局限**：官方质量页和性能页把评估片段写为 **31.25 ms**，而当前代码的 512/16000 与 256/8000 都是 **32 ms**。本文保留两种原始口径，不把它们视为同一个精确时长。[2][6][7]
### 1.2 采样率不是任意值
- **官方事实**：模型直接支持 8 kHz 和 16 kHz；当前工具代码也接受 16 kHz 的整数倍。
- **代码事实**：对 32/48 kHz 等输入，工具代码通过步进抽取降到 16 kHz，而不是执行通用高质量重采样。[2]
- **工程解读**：如果上游音频频带不可控，先用带抗混叠滤波的重采样器转到 16 kHz，更容易得到可复现的输入条件。

### 2.2 为什么需要频谱、卷积和循环状态
- **解释**：频谱前端把时域波形转为频率能量结构，便于区分人声谐波、噪声和静音。
- **解释**：卷积编码器压缩每块内部的短时模式；LSTM 再把块间历史带入当前判断。
- **解释**：因此“32 ms 输入”不等于“只利用 32 ms 信息”；当前概率还受循环状态与 4 ms 波形上下文影响。
- **局限**：官方未发布训练代码、训练数据明细或完整模型论文，不能从公开材料还原训练目标、采样策略和所有网络实现细节。[8]

### 5.3 已知困难样本
v6 Release 明确列出持续存在的问题：带有人声相似乐器的音乐、非常高音的人声（人工声、卡通声、小童声）。v6.2 又声称改善特殊声线、儿童/卡通声、闷声和低质量电话，但没有发布对应的新指标。[5]
**证据结论**：这些改进可作为版本说明事实，不能写成“问题已解决”。

Silero VAD


**Silero VAD** - pre-trained enterprise-grade [Voice Activity Detector](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voice_activity_detection) (also see our [STT models](https://github.com/snakers4/silero-models)).

Real Time Example https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36505480/144874384-95f80f6d-a4f1-42cc-9be7-004c891dd481.mp4 Please note, that video loads only if you are logged in your GitHub account.

Fast start


Dependencies System requirements to run python examples on `x86-64` systems: - `python 3.8+`; - 1G+ RAM; - A modern CPU with AVX, AVX2, AVX-512 or AMX instruction sets. Dependencies: - `torch>=1.12.0`; - `torchaudio>=0.12.0` (for I/O only); - `onnxruntime>=1.16.1` (for ONNX model usage). Silero VAD uses torchaudio library for audio I/O (`torchaudio.info`, `torchaudio.load`, and `torchaudio.save`), so a proper audio backend is required: - Option №1 - [**FFmpeg**](https://www.ffmpeg.org/) backend. `conda install -c conda-forge 'ffmpeg<7'`; - Option №2 - [**sox_io**](https://pypi.org/project/sox/) backend. `apt-get install sox`, TorchAudio is tested on libsox 14.4.2; - Option №3 - [**soundfile**](https://pypi.org/project/soundfile/) backend. `pip install soundfile`. If you are planning to run the VAD using solely the `onnx-runtime`, it will run on any other system architectures where onnx-runtume is [supported](https://onnxruntime.ai/getting-started). In this case please note that: - You will have to implement the I/O; - You will have to adapt the existing wrappers / examples / post-processing for your use-case.
**Using pip**: `pip install silero-vad` ```python3 from silero_vad import load_silero_vad, read_audio, get_speech_timestamps model = load_silero_vad() wav = read_audio('path_to_audio_file') speech_timestamps = get_speech_timestamps( wav, model, return_seconds=True, # Return speech timestamps in seconds (default is samples) ) ``` **Using torch.hub**: ```python3 import torch torch.set_num_threads(1) model, utils = torch.hub.load(repo_or_dir='snakers4/silero-vad', model='silero_vad') (get_speech_timestamps, _, read_audio, _, _) = utils wav = read_audio('path_to_audio_file') speech_timestamps = get_speech_timestamps( wav, model, return_seconds=True, # Return speech timestamps in seconds (default is samples) ) ```

Key Features


- **Stellar accuracy** Silero VAD has [excellent results](https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad/wiki/Quality-Metrics#vs-other-available-solutions) on speech detection tasks. - **Fast** One audio chunk (30+ ms) [takes](https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad/wiki/Performance-Metrics#silero-vad-performance-metrics) less than **1ms** to be processed on a single CPU thread. Using batching or GPU can also improve performance considerably. Under certain conditions ONNX may even run up to 4-5x faster. - **Lightweight** JIT model is around two megabytes in size. - **General** Silero VAD was trained on huge corpora that include over **6000** languages and it performs well on audios from different domains with various background noise and quality levels. - **Flexible sampling rate** Silero VAD [supports](https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad/wiki/Quality-Metrics#sample-rate-comparison) **8000 Hz** and **16000 Hz** [sampling rates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sampling_(signal_processing)#Sampling_rate). - **Highly Portable** Silero VAD reaps benefits from the rich ecosystems built around **PyTorch** and **ONNX** running everywhere where these runtimes are available. - **No Strings Attached** Published under permissive license (MIT) Silero VAD has zero strings attached - no telemetry, no keys, no registration, no built-in expiration, no keys or vendor lock.

Typical Use Cases


- Voice activity detection for IOT / edge / mobile use cases - Data cleaning and preparation, voice detection in general - Telephony and call-center automation, voice bots - Voice interfaces

Links


- [Examples and Dependencies](https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad/wiki/Examples-and-Dependencies#dependencies)

"""Silero-VAD Fast start 跑通示例（JIT 模型）。

对照 README Fast start：
  load_silero_vad() -> read_audio(path) -> get_speech_timestamps(...)
"""
import os
import sys
import time

# 直接用仓库内置的 src（无需 pip 安装包本身）
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

<callout emoji="📝" background-color="light-blue">
本次实验在本地 Ubuntu（x86-64）上拉取官方 Silero-VAD 仓库，搭建独立 Python 环境，分别用 JIT 与 ONNX 两个后端跑通 Fast start，并记录版本、依赖、踩坑与检测结果。
</callout>

## 1. 概览

| 项目 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 仓库来源 | https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad |
| 本地路径 | `/home/zhangyi101/project26/Silero-VAD/` |
| 仓库自带版本 | 包元数据 `silero-vad 6.2.2`（对应最新 Release v6.2.1，2026-02-24） |
| 模型文件 | 随仓库打包于 `src/silero_vad/data/`：JIT + 多个 ONNX |

    silero_vad_16k_op15.onnx

### 3.1 脚本

from silero_vad import load_silero_vad, read_audio, get_speech_timestamps

## 4. 踩坑记录

| 问题 | 现象 | 解决 |
|---|---|---|
| torchaudio 2.11 不再用 sox/soundfile | `RuntimeError: torchaudio 2.11.0 requires torchcodec for audio I/O` | 安装 `torchcodec`（README 建议 `torchaudio<2.9`，但与 torch 2.14 版本不匹配，故走 torchcodec 更顺） |

| 分段层 | 阈值与时长参数、片段数 | 默认 `threshold=0.5` / `neg_threshold≈0.35` / `min_speech 250ms` / `min_silence 100ms` / `speech_pad 30ms`；60s 音频出 19 段 |
| 性能层 | 单块延迟 | 整段（60s）推理+后处理 ~310ms；单块量级符合文档 `<1ms` 口径 |

<callout emoji="📌" background-color="light-blue">
文档强调「模型只输出每块概率，`get_speech_timestamps` 才把概率序列变成时间段」。本次两次调用（return_seconds=False/True）返回的片段数一致，印证分段结果不随返回单位变化。
</callout>

## 转换路径与难点

理论上要自己走 `ONNX → TensorFlow → TFLite (int8) → TFLM`，按飞书文档里的逐层结构看可行性：

| 层 | 结构 | 转 TFLite 难度 |
|---|---|---|
| 上下文拼接 / 右反射填充 | Slice/Concat/Pad | ✅ 好转 |
| 频谱前端 | Conv1d 核256 步128（学到的，非硬 STFT） | ✅ Conv 都支持 |
| 幅度谱拆分 | Split/平方求和 | ✅ 基础算子 |
| 卷积编码器 | 4×Conv1d 129→128→64→64→128 | ✅ |
| 时序层 | **单层单向 LSTM 128→128** | ⚠️ **卡点**：TFLite 的 LSTM 算子和 ONNX LSTM 对接不干净，常需手填或 reshape |
| 概率头 | ReLU+1×1Conv+Sigmoid | ✅ |
| **流式状态** | `(2,B,128)` 状态 + 64 样本上下文跨块传递 | ⚠️ **TFLM 单次推理无状态**，需把 state 当输入输出张量在外部循环管理 |

**两个真正的拦路虎**：
1. **LSTM 层**：ONNX→TF 的 LSTM 转换经常断在权重排布/门序上，得手动核对。
2. **有状态流式**：TFLM 是无状态的，必须把循环状态拆成模型 I/O 张量由宿主侧维护——这正好和你 TFLM 工程里别的有状态模型一个套路，但封装得重写。

"""TFLite 版 Silero VAD (v5 LiteRT) 简要实验。

对比对象：Silero-VAD 仓库 JIT v6（同一段 test.wav 检出 19 段）。
模型：soniqo/Silero-VAD-v5-LiteRT/silero-vad.tflite
  - input[0] audio [1,576]  = 64 上下文 + 512 块
  - input[1] state  [2,1,128] (LSTM h,c)
  - output    prob [1,1]  +  state_out [2,1,128]（顺序不保，按 numel 区分）
"""
import os
import sys
import time
import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf
import tflite_runtime.interpreter as tflite

MODEL = "silero-vad.tflite"
SR = 16000
CTX = 64          # context samples
CHUNK = 512       # chunk samples
# 后处理参数，与官方 get_speech_timestamps 默认一致
THRESHOLD = 0.5
NEG_THRESHOLD = max(THRESHOLD - 0.15, 0.01)
MIN_SPEECH_MS = 250
MIN_SILENCE_MS = 100
SPEECH_PAD_MS = 30


def read_wav_mono(path):
    data, sr = sf.read(path, dtype="float32")
    if data.ndim > 1:
        data = data.mean(axis=1)
    assert sr == SR, f"expect {SR}Hz, got {sr}"
    return data


def run_model(itp, inp_audio, inp_state, idx_in_audio, idx_in_state, out_details):
    prob_idx = state_idx = None
    for d in out_details:
        if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 1:
            prob_idx = d["index"]
        else:
            state_idx = d["index"]
    itp.set_tensor(idx_in_audio, inp_audio)
    itp.set_tensor(idx_in_state, inp_state)
    itp.invoke()
    prob = float(itp.get_tensor(prob_idx).ravel()[0])
    new_state = itp.get_tensor(state_idx)
    return prob, new_state


def collect_probs(itp, wav):
    idx_in = {d["index"]: d for d in itp.get_input_details()}
    ia = next(d["index"] for d in itp.get_input_details() if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 576)
    ist = next(d["index"] for d in itp.get_input_details() if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 256)
    out_details = itp.get_output_details()

    # pad 到 CHUNK 整数倍
    pad = (-len(wav)) % CHUNK
    wav = np.concatenate([wav, np.zeros(pad, dtype="float32")])
    n_chunks = len(wav) // CHUNK

    state = np.zeros((2, 1, 128), dtype="float32")
    context = np.zeros(CTX, dtype="float32")
    probs = np.empty(n_chunks, dtype="float32")

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for i in range(n_chunks):
        chunk = wav[i * CHUNK:(i + 1) * CHUNK]
        audio_in = np.concatenate([context, chunk])[None, :].astype("float32")
        prob, state = run_model(itp, audio_in, state, ia, ist, out_details)
        probs[i] = prob
        context = chunk[-CTX:]
    dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
    return probs, dt


def probs_to_segments(probs, sr=SR):
    """复刻官方 get_speech_timestamps 默认阈值逻辑（样本坐标 -> 秒）。"""
    chunk_ms = CHUNK / sr * 1000  # 32ms
    min_spk = int(MIN_SPEECH_MS / chunk_ms)
    min_sil = int(MIN_SILENCE_MS / chunk_ms)
    pad = int(SPEECH_PAD_MS / chunk_ms)

    segs = []
    in_speech = False
    cur = []
    silence = 0
    for i, p in enumerate(probs):
        if not in_speech:
            if p >= THRESHOLD:
                in_speech = True
                cur = [i, i]
                silence = 0
        else:
            if p < NEG_THRESHOLD:
                silence += 1
                if silence >= min_sil:
                    if (cur[1] - cur[0] + 1) >= min_spk:
                        segs.append([cur[0] - pad, cur[1] + pad])
                    in_speech = False
                    cur = []
                    silence = 0
            else:
                silence = 0
                cur[1] = i
    if in_speech and (cur[1] - cur[0] + 1) >= min_spk:
        segs.append([cur[0] - pad, cur[1] + pad])

    out = []
    for s, e in segs:
        s = max(0, s * chunk_ms / 1000)
        e = (e + 1) * chunk_ms / 1000
        out.append((round(s, 3), round(e, 3)))
    return out


def main():
    wav_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "../Silero-VAD/tests/data/test.wav"
    wav = read_wav_mono(wav_path)
    print(f"audio       : {wav_path}")
    print(f"wav samples : {len(wav)}  dur={len(wav)/SR:.2f}s")

text:
TFLite 版 Silero VAD 跑通了。结果对比：

## 实验结果（同一段 `test.wav`，60s / 16kHz）

| | JIT v6.2.x（官方仓库） | **TFLite v5 LiteRT（soniqo 导出）** |
|---|---|---|
| 模型格式 | `silero_vad.jit` (~2.3MB) | `silero-vad.tflite` (~1.2MB) |
| 运行时 | PyTorch JIT | TFLite / XNNPACK |
| 每块输入 | 512 + 64 上下文 = 576 | 同（[1,576] + state[2,1,128]） |
| 块数 / 块长 | 1875 × 32ms | 1875 × 32ms |
| 推理耗时 | ~310ms（含官方后处理） | 136.5ms 推理 / **每块 0.07ms** |
| 检出段数 | **19 段** | **24 段** |
| 概率分布 | — | min 0.001 / max 1.0 / mean 0.78 |

## 段数差异怎么来的

v5(TFLite) 比 v6(JIT) **多 5 段**，基本是把 v6 里被合并的大段切开了：

- v6 的 `20.3→32.6s`(12.3s 大段) → v5 拆成 `20.4→28.6` + `28.7→32.6`
- v6 的 `9.3→13.3s`(4.0s) → v5 拆成 `9.3→10.3` + `10.4→13.3`
- 另有 0.48–0.97s 的短段被 v5 保留（v6 默认 `min_speech_duration_ms=250ms` 也会滤掉更短的）

两个来源：
1. **版本差**：这是 v5 导出，v6 官方明确说改善了多域/噪声稳定性，分段更不容易碎——和这里 19 vs 24 的方向一致。
2. **后处理实现差**：我用的是默认阈值(0.5/0.35)+250ms/100ms/30ms 的简版复刻；官方 `get_speech_timestamps` 还有 `max_speech_duration_s`、`use_max_poss_sil_at_max_speech` 等会进一步合并/切分，所以 v5 的 24 段只是「同等阈值下的近似」，不是官方口径。

## 关于 TFLM

关键结论：**Silero VAD 确实存在可用的 `.tflite`**（第三方 soniqo 导出的 v5 LiteRT 版），接口干净（576 样本 + 256 状态，输出 prob + 新 state），用 `tflite-runtime` 在 CPU 上每块 0.07ms。它**天然适合 TFLM**：
- 输入/状态都是 float32 定长张量，状态在宿主侧循环传递——正是 TFLM 的标准无状态调用模式
- 模型只有 conv + LSTM + sigmoid，int8 量化后应能塞进 MCU

唯一要注意：**tflite 转换不保输出顺序**（实测 state 在前、prob 在后），代码里按 numel 区分（注释也这么写）。

## 1. 入口与整体流程

**仓库定位**（`README.md:1-13`，`AGENTS.md:1-10`）：这是 MiWear 可穿戴设备 ML 模型的 TFLite 转换/量化/TFLM 部署工具集。所有产物面向 TFLM（TFLite Micro）部署。

**两条独立的量化流水线**（`AGENTS.md:46-101`）：

| 流水线 | 输入 | 适用模型 | 量化器 |
|---|---|---|---|
| A：ONNX → TFLite + AIQ 量化 | `.onnx` | pnet / accnet / pnet_v3 / accnet_v3 | `TFLiteConverter`（全 INT8）或 `ai-edge-quantizer`（w8a16 静态 / 动态选择性） |
| B：已有 TFLite → Custom Op Fusion + Hybrid Int8 | `.tflite`（预训练） | attengru / attengru_v3 / sleeping | `tflite_attengru_fix.py` + `tflite_hybrid_quantize.py`（per-channel int8 权重，激活 float32） |

**关键结论：本仓库没有「直接拿一个第三方 .tflite → 全整型 INT8 量化」的标准脚本。** 流水线 A 必须从 ONNX 出发（因为要用 `tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_saved_model`，需要 SavedModel，而 SavedModel 由 `onnx2tf` 从 ONNX 生成，见 `ptq_pipeline/ptq_converter.py:49-97`）。流水线 B 走 flatbuffer 直改的 hybrid per-channel int8（仅权重量化，激活仍为 float32），见 `ptq_pipeline/tflite_hybrid_quantize.py:48-91`。

`docs/` 下分两层：`00-index.md` ~ `09-references-and-ignored.md` 是模型分目录的 how-to 手册；`TFLITE_QUANTIZATION_GUIDE.md` / `ONNX_TO_TFLITE_CONVERSION.md` / `TFLITE_POST_PROCESSING.md` / `MODEL_ARCHITECTURE_ANALYSIS.md` 是主题文档。`docs/superpowers/` 可忽略。

## 2. 关键脚本

### `ptq_convert_onnx_to_tflite.py`（`/home/zhangyi101/project26/miwear_ai_models_ptq_tools-main/ptq_convert_onnx_to_tflite.py`）

## 3. 一个完整 PTQ 示例：AttenGRU v3（带状态循环模型，最贴近 Silero VAD）

AttenGRU v3 是这个仓库里**唯一带状态输入**的模型，对 Silero VAD 适配最有参考价值。下面是完整链路。

**目录结构**（`PTQ_hr_attengru/`）：
- `source/attengru_float32_v3.tflite`（600 KB，227 ops，5 个 subgraph，含 GRU WHILE 子图）— 上游提供的 float32 源 tflite。
- `source/test_data_v3.npz`（8.9 MB，2000 样本）— 回归测试集。
- `scripts/extract_v3_test_data.py` — 从外部 `v3_models/test_data/model_io.pkl`（20 条 stateful 轨迹 × 622 步）生成 npz。
- `scripts/simulate_hybrid_v3.py` — PC 端 weight-only int8 round-trip 模拟（因为 fused tflite 含 custom op，PC 跑不了，只能在 source 上模拟）。
- `scripts/generate_ref.py` — 从 source tflite 生成 50 seed 参考基线。
- `scripts/regression_test.py` / `evaluate_v3.py` — 回归测试 / 精度评估。

**Makefile 目标**（`PTQ_hr_attengru/Makefile`，行 1-90）：
```
SRC_MODEL_V3   := source/attengru_float32_v3.tflite
FUSED_V3       := models_v3/attengru_v3_fused.tflite
HYBRID_FULL_V3 := models_v3/attengru_v3_fused_hybrid.tflite

v3: v3-fuse v3-quantize v3-eval v3-simulate
```

**关键调用命令原文**：
- Fusion：`python -m ptq_pipeline.tflite_attengru_fix source/attengru_float32_v3.tflite -o models_v3/attengru_v3_fused.tflite`
- Hybrid 量化：`python -m ptq_pipeline.tflite_hybrid_quantize models_v3/attengru_v3_fused.tflite models_v3/attengru_v3_fused_hybrid.tflite --mode full`

**校准数据准备**（`PTQ_hr_attengru/scripts/extract_v3_test_data.py:4-31`）—— **这是处理 stateful 模型的核心模式**：
> 模型是 stateful 的：step t 的输入是 `x[t], time_encoder_output[t], h0=gru1_hidden[t-1], h1=gru2_hidden[t-1]`，输出是 `hr[t], std[t], gru1_hidden[t], gru2_hidden[t]`，初始 `h0=h1=zeros`。
> **把整条轨迹按 step 展平成独立单步样本**，每个样本自带 `(x, time, h0, h1)` 四个输入，不依赖序列状态。

展开逻辑（行 76-106）：
```python
for i in range(n_seq):
    for s in range(T):
        flat_x.append(x_seq[0, s].reshape(1, 1, 232).astype(np.float32))
        flat_time.append(t_seq[s].reshape(1, 2, 64).astype(np.float32))
        if s == 0:
            flat_h0.append(np.zeros((1, 64), dtype=np.float32))
            flat_h1.append(np.zeros((1, 64), dtype=np.float32))
        else:
            flat_h0.append(g1_seq[0, s - 1].reshape(1, 64).astype(np.float32))
            flat_h1.append(g2_seq[0, s - 1].reshape(1, 64).astype(np.float32))
```
然后随机采样 2000 个存成 npz（行 111-127），key 格式：`input_{i}_{name}`、`output_{i}_{name}`，4 个输入名 `["x", "ppg_time_feature", "h0", "h1"]`，4 个输出名 `["Identity", "Identity_1", "Identity_2", "Identity_3"]`（见 `simulate_hybrid_v3.py:48-55`）。

**关键点**：AttenGRU 走的是 **Hybrid per-channel int8**（仅权重量化，激活保持 float32），**不需要 representative_dataset**（`tflite_hybrid_quantize.py:48-91` 直接按 `abs_max/127` 计算 per-row scale，不跑校准推理）。状态输入 h0/h1 作为额外 input tensor 进入模型，不参与量化 scale 计算。

---

## 4. INT8 量化具体怎么做

仓库里有**三套**不同的 INT8 量化实现：

### (a) TF `TFLiteConverter` 全整型 INT8（流水线 A，pnet/accnet）
`ptq_pipeline/ptq_converter.py:100-122`：
```python
converter = tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_saved_model(saved_model_dir)
converter.optimizations = [tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT]
converter.target_spec.supported_ops = [tf.lite.OpsSet.TFLITE_BUILTINS_INT8]
converter.inference_input_type = tf.int8
converter.inference_output_type = tf.int8
converter.representative_dataset = create_representative_dataset(calibration_data)
```
`create_representative_dataset`（行 40-46）：逐样本 `yield [sample]`，**单输入假设**。这是标准 TFLite 全整型量化（权重+激活 int8）。

### (b) AIQ `ai-edge-quantizer` 静态 w8a16 / 动态（流水线 A 补充，pnet）
`selective_quantization_final.py:42-106`（静态）、`114-138`（动态）。AIQ 的 `Quantizer(float_tflite_path)` **直接吃 tflite**，不需要 SavedModel。静态校准样本格式（行 26-34）：
```python
samples = [{"input1": calibration_data[i:i+1]} for i in range(num_calibration)]
{"serving_default": samples}
```

### (c) flatbuffer 直改 per-channel int8 hybrid（流水线 B，attengru/sleeping）
`ptq_pipeline/tflite_hybrid_quantize.py:24-91`：直接读 flatbuffer，对 FC/GRU/MHA 的 weight tensor 按 `abs_max/127` per-row 量化、写回 buffer，改 tensor type 为 int8（type=9），挂 `QuantizationParametersT`。**激活保持 float32**，不需要 representative dataset。SKIP_SHAPES={(3,7),(1,32)} 跳过小 FC 权重。

**LSTM / 状态输入处理**：仓库里没有原生 LSTM 处理。AttenGRU 的 GRU 是被 PyTorch 导出成 `WHILE` 子图（`tflite_attengru_fix.py:189-220`），fusion 时从 WHILE body 子图里抽出 input kernel / recurrent kernel 两个 FC 权重（`_find_gru_weights`，行 221-260），替换成 `UNIDIRECTIONAL_SEQUENCE_GRU` custom op（行 460-470）。状态 h0/h1 作为外部 input tensor 直通进 custom op，**不进入量化 scale 推导**。

**是否需要特殊算子注册**：

**Silero VAD v5 的输入输出**（按你的描述）：

### 难点 1：representative dataset 喂带状态的模型

**仓库里的先例就是 AttenGRU v3**（§3）：把多条真实音频轨迹跑 float32 模型，记录每一步的 state，然后按 step 展平成独立样本，每个样本包含 `(audio_chunk, state)` 全部输入。`PTQ_hr_attengru/scripts/extract_v3_test_data.py:76-106` 就是这个逻辑。

def quantize(input_path, output_path, mode):
    model = flatbuffer_utils.read_model(input_path)
    sg = model.subgraphs[0]
    count = 0

    for op in sg.operators:
        oc = model.operatorCodes[op.opcodeIndex]

        if oc.builtinCode == 9 and mode == "full":
            w_t = sg.tensors[op.inputs[1]]
            if tuple(w_t.shape) in SKIP_SHAPES:
                continue
            if w_t.type == 0:
                if quantize_weight_tensor(model, sg, op.inputs[1]):
                    count += 1

        if oc.builtinCode == 32:
            cname = (
                oc.customCode.decode()
                if isinstance(oc.customCode, bytes)
                else oc.customCode
            )
            if cname == "UNIDIRECTIONAL_SEQUENCE_GRU":
                for idx in [op.inputs[2], op.inputs[4]]:
                    if sg.tensors[idx].type == 0:
                        if quantize_weight_tensor(model, sg, idx):
                            count += 1
            elif cname == "MULTI_HEAD_ATTENTION" and mode == "full":
                for idx in [op.inputs[1], op.inputs[3], op.inputs[5], op.inputs[7]]:
                    if sg.tensors[idx].type == 0:
                        if quantize_weight_tensor(model, sg, idx):
                            count += 1

    flatbuffer_utils.write_model(model, output_path)
    print(
        "%s: %d weights quantized, %.1f KB → %.1f KB"
        % (
            mode,
            count,
            os.path.getsize(input_path) / 1024,

# Silero VAD int8 量化 + TFLM C 端集成

## Context

承接前序实验：已用 TFLite 版 Silero VAD v5（`soniqo/Silero-VAD-v5-LiteRT/silero-vad.tflite`）在 PC 上跑通（`/home/zhangyi101/project26/TFLite-VAD/`）。现要把它推到两步：
1. 用 `miwear_ai_models_ptq_tools-main` 工具做 **Hybrid 仅权重量化**（权重 int8 + 激活 float32），PC 上验证精度对齐。
2. 照 `vela-miwear-bes-o62-25rc05-tflm/apps/mlearning/tflite-micro` 框架写好 **C 端集成代码**（不烧录，由用户在有设备时构建）。

已探明的关键事实：
- `silero-vad.tflite` 共 70 ops、122 tensors、19 opcodes。**无 LSTM builtin**——LSTM 被拆成 RESHAPE/ADD/SLICE/MUL/FULLY_CONNECTED/TANH/LOGISTIC 等基础算子；含控制流算子 SQRT/LESS/SELECT/GATHER_ND。
- 输入 `audio[1,576]` + `state[2,1,128]`，输出 `state_out[2,1,128]`(idx121) + `prob[1,1]`(idx119)——**顺序不保**，按 numel 区分。
- 现成 `ptq_pipeline/tflite_hybrid_quantize.py` 只处理 FULLY_CONNECTED(opcode 9)，**不处理 CONV_2D(3)/DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D(4)**，需扩展（Silero 有 5×Conv2D + 1×DepthwiseConv2D + 2×FC）。
- PTQ venv：`miwear_ai_models_ptq_tools-main/.venv`（TF 2.20 / ai-edge-quantizer 0.4.1 / ai-edge-litert 2.1.0 / flatbuffers / tflite schema）。
- 导入 `ai_edge_litert`+`tf.lite` 的脚本顶部必须加 fake module shim（TF 2.20 import order bug，见 AGENTS.md:115-119）。
- TFLM 最贴近模板：`hr_attengru_test.cc`（多输入多输出 + 状态化 RNN）；QEMU/sim 版见 `sleep_qemu_test.cc`；算子注册模板见 `hr_pnet_test.cc`。
- 状态循环范式：interpreter 循环外建一次，每帧填 audio+state → Invoke → 读 prob+state_out → 把 state_out 拷回下帧 state 输入（见 `hr_attengru_test.cc:136-149`/`:188-212`）。
- `build_tflm.sh` 是真机烧录（sudo dldtool /dev/ttyACM0 + minicom），需物理设备——**本次不做**。

## Phase 1：PC 端 Hybrid 量化 + 精度验证

### 1.1 新建目录
`miwear_ai_models_ptq_tools-main/PTQ_silero_vad/`，仿 `PTQ_hr_attengru/` 结构：
```
PTQ_silero_vad/
  source/silero-vad.tflite          # 复制自 TFLite-VAD/
  models/silero-vad-hybrid.tflite   # 量化产物
  scripts/
    quantize_hybrid.py             # 扩展的 hybrid 量化
    verify_accuracy.py              # 量化前后精度对齐
```
不进顶层 `Makefile` 的 `MODELS` 列表（避免污染现有流水线）。

### 1.2 量化脚本 `quantize_hybrid.py`
基于 `ptq_pipeline/tflite_hybrid_quantize.py:48-91`（`quantize()` / `quantize_weight_tensor()`）扩展：
- 顶部照搬 fake module shim（`tflite_hybrid_quantize.py:9-15`）。
- 在 `quantize()` 的算子循环里，除 `builtinCode==9`(FULLY_CONNECTED) 外，**新增 `builtinCode==3`(CONV_2D) 和 `builtinCode==4`(DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D)**：权重张量都是 `op.inputs[1]`，调同一 `quantize_weight_tensor()`（per-channel abs_max/127，写回 type=int8 + QuantizationParametersT）。
- DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D 的 TFLM hybrid kernel 支持不确定 → 先尝试，若 verify 阶段 int8 版跑不通或精度崩，则**选择性跳过 DepthwiseConv2D 权重**（仅 1 个 op，保持 float32 影响小），仿 `selective_quantization_final.py` 的跳层模式。
- 不需要 representative dataset（hybrid 不跑校准推理）。
- 调用：`PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python PTQ_silero_vad/scripts/quantize_hybrid.py source/silero-vad.tflite models/silero-vad-hybrid.tflite`

### 1.3 精度验证 `verify_accuracy.py`
复用 `TFLite-VAD/run_tflite_vad.py` 的跑模型逻辑，但对比 float32 源模型 vs hybrid 模型：
- 用同一 `test.wav`（60s/16k），按 512 样本分块 + 64 上下文循环推理，状态首块置零。
- 对每个 chunk 记录两模型的 prob，统计 mean/max/p95/p99 误差；统计段数对比（float32 基线 24 段）。
- 解释器用 `ai_edge_litert.interpreter.Interpreter`（仓库 AGENTS.md:120-123 口径）或 tflite_runtime，需处理「输出顺序不保」——按 numel 区分 prob(1) / state(256)。
- 产出表格：`模型 | 体积 | 每块ms | 段数 | prob MAE | prob P99`。

## Phase 2：TFLM C 端集成代码

### 2.1 新增 example 目录
`vela-miwear-bes-o62-25rc05-tflm/apps/mlearning/tflite-micro/tflite-micro/tensorflow/lite/micro/examples/silero_vad_test/`，含：
- `silero_vad_test.cc`：照 `hr_attengru_test.cc` + `sleep_qemu_test.cc` 写。
- `silero_vad_test.h`（如需）/ `README`。

### 2.2 `silero_vad_test.cc` 关键结构
照 `sleep_board_test.cc:21-45,57`（文件加载 `tflite::GetModel`）、`:72-79`（resolver）、`:81-97`（arena+interpreter）、`:101-141`（invoke 循环）；多输入多输出遍历照 `hr_attengru_test.cc:136-149,188-212`：
- **算子注册** `MicroMutableOpResolver<N>`：覆盖实测算子表——RESHAPE/ADD/SLICE/TRANSPOSE/MUL/CONV_2D/LOGISTIC/ABS/SUB/PAD/FULLY_CONNECTED/TANH/LESS/SELECT/GATHER_ND/DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D/SQRT/RELU/CONCATENATION + QUANTIZE/DEQUANTIZE（hybrid 权重需要）。先在 `micro_mutable_op_resolver.h` 核对每个 Add* 是否存在；不存在的（如 GATHER_ND/SELECT/ABS/SQRT）需确认 TFLM 版本支持，必要时注册上游算子。N 按 final 列表定。
- **状态循环**：interpreter 一次创建；每帧 memcpy audio[576] → input(0)，state[2,1,128] → input(1)（首帧零）；Invoke；读 prob = output(numel==1)->data.f[0]，state_out = output(numel==256)；把 state_out memcpy 回下帧 input(1)。
- **arena**：先用 `RecordingMicroAllocator` + `LogAllocatorEvents`（`sleep_board_test.cc:196`）dump 实际占用，Silero 约 80–256KB，初值给 256KB。
- **模型/数据来源**：`tflm_test_util::LoadDataFile("silero_vad_hybrid.tflite")` 从 `/data/` 读（真机）或 `/host/`（sim）。

### 2.3 Kconfig + CMakeLists
- `tflite-micro/Kconfig` 末尾（`endif` 前）加 `CONFIG_TFLITEMICRO_SILERO_VAD_TEST` + PRIORITY/STACKSIZE，仿 `:106-119` sleep_test 块。
- `tflite-micro/CMakeLists.txt` 加 `nuttx_add_application(NAME silero_vad_test ...)`，`SRCS` 指向 `silero_vad_test.cc`，仿 `:410-445`。若存在 sim/qemu 分支则仿 `:415-422` sleep 的 `sleep_qemu_test.cc` 处理。

### 2.4 集成说明（不构建）
写一份 `silero_vad_test/README.md`：模型文件放 `/data/silero_vad_hybrid.tflite`、`menuconfig` 路径（Machine Learning Support → Silero VAD test）、`build_tflm.sh` 构建+烧录命令、预期串口输出（prob 序列）。由用户在有设备时执行。

## Verification

**PC 端（实跑）**：
1. `cd miwear_ai_models_ptq_tools-main && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python PTQ_silero_vad/scripts/quantize_hybrid.py source/silero-vad.tflite models/silero-vad-hybrid.tflite` → 产物体积应 ~0.5–0.8× 源（1.2MB）。
2. `.venv/bin/python PTQ_silero_vad/scripts/verify_accuracy.py` → 输出对比表：段数应仍为 24±1，prob MAE < 0.02、P99 < 0.1（hybrid 权重量化典型精度）。

**C 端（代码交付，不构建）**：
3. `silero_vad_test.cc`、Kconfig、CMakeLists 写好，`grep` 确认算子注册表覆盖 Phase 0 实测的全部 opcode。
4. README 给出 `build_tflm.sh` 烧录 + minicom 验证步骤。

## Out of Scope
- 真机固件构建/烧录（`build_tflm.sh`，需物理设备 + sudo）——交付代码与说明，用户自行执行。
- Full int8 (w8a8) 全整型量化（需对 SQRT/LESS/SELECT/GATHER_ND 做图手术）——本次不做，hybrid 跑通后可作为后续。
- 量化模型在 QEMU/sim 仿真构建——本次不配，按用户选择仅 PC 验证 + C 代码。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hybrid per-channel int8 weight quantization for Silero VAD tflite.

权重 int8 + 激活 float32,不需要 representative dataset。
扩展自 ptq_pipeline/tflite_hybrid_quantize.py:48-91,新增 CONV_2D(3) / DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D(4)。

Silero VAD v5 算子表(实测):
  FULLY_CONNECTED(9) x2  权重 [out,in]        axis=0
  CONV_2D(3) x5           权重 [out,H,W,in]    axis=0
  DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D(4) x1 权重 [1,H,W,IO]      axis=-1
"""

import argparse
import os
import sys
import types

# TF 2.20 import order bug workaround (AGENTS.md:115-119)
fake_mod = types.ModuleType(
    "tensorflow.lite.python.metrics._pywrap_tensorflow_lite_metrics_wrapper"
)
fake_mod.MetricsWrapper = type("MetricsWrapper", (), {})
sys.modules[
    "tensorflow.lite.python.metrics._pywrap_tensorflow_lite_metrics_wrapper"
] = fake_mod

import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
from tensorflow.lite.python import schema_py_generated as schema  # noqa: E402
from tensorflow.lite.tools import flatbuffer_utils  # noqa: E402

# builtinCode: 3=CONV_2D, 4=DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D, 9=FULLY_CONNECTED
OP_AXES = {
    3: 0,   # Conv2D weights [out,H,W,in] -> per out_channel
    9: 0,   # FC weights [out,in] -> per out
    4: -1,  # DepthwiseConv2D weights [1,H,W,IO] -> per IO channel (last dim)
}
OP_NAMES = {3: "CONV_2D", 4: "DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D", 9: "FULLY_CONNECTED"}


def quantize_weight_axis(model, sg, tensor_idx, axis):
    """per-channel int8 量化单个权重张量, axis 指定 per-channel 维度。"""
    t = sg.tensors[tensor_idx]
    buf = model.buffers[t.buffer]
    if buf.data is None or len(buf.data) == 0:
        return False
    w = np.frombuffer(bytes(buf.data), dtype=np.float32).reshape(t.shape)

    if axis < 0:
        axis = w.ndim + axis
    n_chan = w.shape[axis]
    # 把 axis 移到 0 方便遍历
    w_m = np.moveaxis(w, axis, 0)  # [n_chan, ...]
    flat = w_m.reshape(n_chan, -1)

    scales = np.zeros(n_chan, dtype=np.float32)
    w_q = np.zeros_like(w_m, dtype=np.int8)
    for i in range(n_chan):
        abs_max = np.abs(flat[i]).max()
        scales[i] = abs_max / 127.0 if abs_max > 0 else 1.0
        if abs_max > 0:
            w_q[i] = np.clip(np.round(w_m[i] / scales[i]), -127, 127).astype(np.int8)
    # 移回原轴序
    w_q = np.moveaxis(w_q, 0, axis)

    buf.data = list(w_q.tobytes())
    t.type = 9  # INT8
    q = schema.QuantizationParametersT()
    q.scale = scales.tolist()
    q.zeroPoint = [0] * n_chan
    q.quantizedDimension = axis
    t.quantization = q
    return True


def quantize(input_path, output_path, skip_depthwise=False):
    model = flatbuffer_utils.read_model(input_path)
    sg = model.subgraphs[0]
    counts = {k: 0 for k in OP_AXES}
    skipped = 0

    for op in sg.operators:
        oc = model.operatorCodes[op.opcodeIndex]
        code = oc.builtinCode

        if code not in OP_AXES:
            continue
        if code == 4 and skip_depthwise:
            skipped += 1
            continue

        w_idx = op.inputs[1]  # 三类算子权重都在 inputs[1]
        w_t = sg.tensors[w_idx]
        if w_t.type != 0:  # 0=FLOAT32,已量化的跳过
            continue
        axis = OP_AXES[code]
        if quantize_weight_axis(model, sg, w_idx, axis):
            counts[code] += 1

    flatbuffer_utils.write_model(model, output_path)
    in_kb = os.path.getsize(input_path) / 1024
    out_kb = os.path.getsize(output_path) / 1024
    print("=== hybrid quant summary ===")
    for code, n in counts.items():
        print(f"  {OP_NAMES[code]:20s}({code}): {n} weight tensors quantized")
    if skipped:
        print(f"  DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D skipped: {skipped}")
    print(f"  size: {in_kb:.1f} KB -> {out_kb:.1f} KB  ({out_kb/in_kb*100:.1f}%)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("input", help="float32 source tflite")
    p.add_argument("output", help="hybrid int8-weight tflite")
    p.add_argument("--skip-depthwise", action="store_true",
                   help="keep DepthwiseConv2D weights float32")
    a = p.parse_args()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""对比 Silero VAD float32 源模型 vs hybrid int8-权重模型的精度。

用同一 test.wav,相同的分块/状态循环,逐块比较 prob。
段数用默认阈值(0.5/0.35)后处理,对比 float32 基线。
"""

import argparse
import os
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf
import tflite_runtime.interpreter as tflite

SR = 16000
CTX = 64
CHUNK = 512
THRESHOLD = 0.5
NEG_THRESHOLD = max(THRESHOLD - 0.15, 0.01)
MIN_SPEECH_MS = 250
MIN_SILENCE_MS = 100
SPEECH_PAD_MS = 30


def read_wav(path):
    data, sr = sf.read(path, dtype="float32")
    if data.ndim > 1:
        data = data.mean(axis=1)
    assert sr == SR
    return data


def make_interp(model_path):
    itp = tflite.Interpreter(model_path=model_path)
    itp.allocate_tensors()
    in_det = itp.get_input_details()
    out_det = itp.get_output_details()
    ia = next(d["index"] for d in in_det if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 576)
    ist = next(d["index"] for d in in_det if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 256)
    prob_idx = next(d["index"] for d in out_det if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 1)
    state_idx = next(d["index"] for d in out_det if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 256)
    return itp, ia, ist, prob_idx, state_idx


def run_chunk(itp, ia, ist, prob_idx, state_idx, audio_in, state):
    itp.set_tensor(ia, audio_in)
    itp.set_tensor(ist, state)
    itp.invoke()
    prob = float(itp.get_tensor(prob_idx).ravel()[0])
    new_state = itp.get_tensor(state_idx).copy()
    return prob, new_state


def collect_probs(model_path, wav):
    itp, ia, ist, prob_idx, state_idx = make_interp(model_path)
    pad = (-len(wav)) % CHUNK
    wav = np.concatenate([wav, np.zeros(pad, dtype="float32")])
    n = len(wav) // CHUNK
    state = np.zeros((2, 1, 128), dtype="float32")
    ctx = np.zeros(CTX, dtype="float32")
    probs = np.empty(n, dtype="float32")
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for i in range(n):
        chunk = wav[i * CHUNK:(i + 1) * CHUNK]
        audio_in = np.concatenate([ctx, chunk])[None, :].astype("float32")
        prob, state = run_chunk(itp, ia, ist, prob_idx, state_idx, audio_in, state)
        probs[i] = prob
        ctx = chunk[-CTX:]
    dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
    return probs, dt


def probs_to_segments(probs):
    chunk_ms = CHUNK / SR * 1000
    min_spk = int(MIN_SPEECH_MS / chunk_ms)
    min_sil = int(MIN_SILENCE_MS / chunk_ms)
    pad = int(SPEECH_PAD_MS / chunk_ms)
    segs = []
    in_sp = False
    cur = []
    sil = 0
    for i, p in enumerate(probs):
        if not in_sp:
            if p >= THRESHOLD:
                in_sp = True
                cur = [i, i]
                sil = 0
        else:
            if p < NEG_THRESHOLD:
                sil += 1
                if sil >= min_sil:
                    if cur[1] - cur[0] + 1 >= min_spk:
                        segs.append([cur[0] - pad, cur[1] + pad])
                    in_sp = False
                    cur = []
                    sil = 0
            else:
                sil = 0
                cur[1] = i
    if in_sp and cur[1] - cur[0] + 1 >= min_spk:
        segs.append([cur[0] - pad, cur[1] + pad])
    out = []
    for s, e in segs:
        s = max(0, s * chunk_ms / 1000)
        e = (e + 1) * chunk_ms / 1000
        out.append((round(s, 3), round(e, 3)))
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--float", default="source/silero-vad.tflite")
    ap.add_argument("--hybrid", default="models/silero-vad-hybrid.tflite")
    ap.add_argument("--wav", default="/home/zhangyi101/project26/Silero-VAD/tests/data/test.wav")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    wav = read_wav(a.wav)
    print(f"audio: {a.wav}  dur={len(wav)/SR:.2f}s  chunks={len(wav)//CHUNK}")

    pf, tf = collect_probs(a.float, wav)
    ph, th = collect_probs(a.hybrid, wav)

    err = np.abs(pf - ph)
    seg_f = probs_to_segments(pf)
    seg_h = probs_to_segments(ph)

    print("\n=== 模型对比 ===")
    print(f"{'指标':24s} {'float32':>12s} {'hybrid':>12s}")
    print(f"{'体积(KB)':24s} {os.path.getsize(a.float)/1024:12.1f} {os.path.getsize(a.hybrid)/1024:12.1f}")
    print(f"{'推理总ms':24s} {tf*1000:12.1f} {th*1000:12.1f}")
    print(f"{'每块ms':24s} {tf/len(pf)*1000:12.3f} {th/len(ph)*1000:12.3f}")
    print(f"{'prob min':24s} {pf.min():12.4f} {ph.min():12.4f}")
    print(f"{'prob max':24s} {pf.max():12.4f} {ph.max():12.4f}")
    print(f"{'prob mean':24s} {pf.mean():12.4f} {ph.mean():12.4f}")
    print(f"{'检出段数':24s} {len(seg_f):12d} {len(seg_h):12d}")

    print("\n=== prob 误差(float - hybrid) ===")
    print(f"  MAE  = {err.mean():.6f}")
    print(f"  max  = {err.max():.6f}")
    print(f"  P95  = {np.percentile(err, 95):.6f}")
    print(f"  P99  = {np.percentile(err, 99):.6f}")

    if len(seg_f) == len(seg_h):
        bd = np.array([(e - s) - (eh - sh) for (s, e), (sh, eh) in zip(seg_f, seg_h)])
        print(f"\n段长差异 mean={bd.mean():.4f}s max={np.abs(bd).max():.4f}s")
    else:
        print(f"\n段数不同({len(seg_f)} vs {len(seg_h)}),列前 10 段对比:")
        for i in range(min(10, max(len(seg_f), len(seg_h)))):
            f = seg_f[i] if i < len(seg_f) else None
            h = seg_h[i] if i < len(seg_h) else None
            print(f"  [{i+1:>2}] float={f}  hybrid={h}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

CHUNK = 512
THRESHOLD = 0.5
NEG_THRESHOLD = max(THRESHOLD - 0.15, 0.01)
MIN_SPEECH_MS = 250
MIN_SILENCE_MS = 100
SPEECH_PAD_MS = 30


def read_wav(path):
    w = wave.open(path, "rb")
    assert w.getframerate() == SR and w.getnchannels() == 1 and w.getsampwidth() == 2, \
        f"need 16k/mono/int16 wav, got {w.getframerate()}/{w.getnchannels()}/{w.getsampwidth()*8}"
    wav = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
    return wav


def make_interp(model_path):
    itp = tf.lite.Interpreter(model_path=model_path)
    itp.allocate_tensors()
    in_det = itp.get_input_details()
    out_det = itp.get_output_details()
    ia = next(d["index"] for d in in_det if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 576)
    ist = next(d["index"] for d in in_det if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 256)
    prob_idx = next(d["index"] for d in out_det if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 1)
    state_idx = next(d["index"] for d in out_det if np.prod(d["shape"]) == 256)
    return itp, ia, ist, prob_idx, state_idx


def collect_probs(model_path, wav):
    itp, ia, ist, prob_idx, state_idx = make_interp(model_path)
    pad = (-len(wav)) % CHUNK
    wav = np.concatenate([wav, np.zeros(pad, dtype="float32")])
    n = len(wav) // CHUNK
    state = np.zeros((2, 1, 128), dtype=np.float32)
    ctx = np.zeros(CTX, dtype="float32")
    probs = np.empty(n, dtype=np.float32)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for i in range(n):
        chunk = wav[i * CHUNK:(i + 1) * CHUNK]
        audio_in = np.concatenate([ctx, chunk])[None, :].astype(np.float32)
        itp.set_tensor(ia, audio_in)
        itp.set_tensor(ist, state)
        itp.invoke()
        probs[i] = float(itp.get_tensor(prob_idx).ravel()[0])
        state = itp.get_tensor(state_idx).copy()
        ctx = chunk[-CTX:]
    dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
    return probs, dt


def probs_to_segments(probs):
    chunk_ms = CHUNK / SR * 1000
    min_spk = int(MIN_SPEECH_MS / chunk_ms)
    min_sil = int(MIN_SILENCE_MS / chunk_ms)
    pad = int(SPEECH_PAD_MS / chunk_ms)
    segs = []
    in_sp = False
    cur = []
    sil = 0
    for i, p in enumerate(probs):
        if not in_sp:
            if p >= THRESHOLD:
                in_sp = True
                cur = [i, i]
                sil = 0
        else:
            if p < NEG_THRESHOLD:
                sil += 1
                if sil >= min_sil:
                    if cur[1] - cur[0] + 1 >= min_spk:
                        segs.append([cur[0] - pad, cur[1] + pad])
                    in_sp = False
                    cur = []
                    sil = 0
            else:
                sil = 0
                cur[1] = i
    if in_sp and cur[1] - cur[0] + 1 >= min_spk:
        segs.append([cur[0] - pad, cur[1] + pad])
    out = []
    for s, e in segs:
        s = max(0, s * chunk_ms / 1000)
        e = (e + 1) * chunk_ms / 1000
        out.append((round(s, 3), round(e, 3)))
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--float", default="source/silero-vad.tflite")
    ap.add_argument("--hybrid", default="models/silero-vad-hybrid.tflite")
    ap.add_argument("--wav", default="/home/zhangyi101/project26/Silero-VAD/tests/data/test.wav")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    wav = read_wav(a.wav)
    print(f"audio: {a.wav}  dur={len(wav)/SR:.2f}s  chunks={len(wav)//CHUNK}")

    pf, tf_ = collect_probs(a.float, wav)
    ph, th = collect_probs(a.hybrid, wav)

    err = np.abs(pf - ph)
    seg_f = probs_to_segments(pf)
    seg_h = probs_to_segments(ph)

    print("\n=== 模型对比 ===")
    print(f"{'指标':20s} {'float32':>14s} {'hybrid':>14s}")
    print(f"{'体积(KB)':20s} {os.path.getsize(a.float)/1024:14.1f} {os.path.getsize(a.hybrid)/1024:14.1f}")
    print(f"{'推理总ms':20s} {tf_*1000:14.1f} {th*1000:14.1f}")
    print(f"{'每块ms':20s} {tf_/len(pf)*1000:14.4f} {th/len(ph)*1000:14.4f}")
    print(f"{'prob min':20s} {pf.min():14.4f} {ph.min():14.4f}")
    print(f"{'prob max':20s} {pf.max():14.4f} {ph.max():14.4f}")
    print(f"{'prob mean':20s} {pf.mean():14.4f} {ph.mean():14.4f}")
    print(f"{'检出段数':20s} {len(seg_f):14d} {len(seg_h):14d}")

    print("\n=== prob 误差(float - hybrid) ===")
    print(f"  MAE  = {err.mean():.6f}")
    print(f"  max  = {err.max():.6f}")
    print(f"  P95  = {np.percentile(err, 95):.6f}")
    print(f"  P99  = {np.percentile(err, 99):.6f}")

    if len(seg_f) == len(seg_h):
        bd = np.array([(e - s) - (eh - sh) for (s, e), (sh, eh) in zip(seg_f, seg_h)])
        print(f"\n段长差异 mean={bd.mean():.4f}s max={np.abs(bd).max():.4f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""把模型里 deprecated 的 SELECT op(code 64) 改成 SELECT_V2(code 123)。

TFLM(本仓库) 只有 Register_SELECT_V2(),无 SELECT kernel;
而 soniqo 导出的 silero-vad.tflite 用的是 deprecated SELECT(code 64)。
两者语义在 element-wise 同形状时等价(SELECT_V2 是超集,支持广播)。
本模型 SELECT: cond[640]bool + a[640]int32 + b[640]int32 -> out[640]int32,
全同形状,可安全改 opcode。
"""
import argparse
import sys
import types

fake_mod = types.ModuleType(
    "tensorflow.lite.python.metrics._pywrap_tensorflow_lite_metrics_wrapper"
)
fake_mod.MetricsWrapper = type("MetricsWrapper", (), {})
sys.modules[
    "tensorflow.lite.python.metrics._pywrap_tensorflow_lite_metrics_wrapper"
] = fake_mod

from tensorflow.lite.tools import flatbuffer_utils  # noqa: E402

SELECT = 64
SELECT_V2 = 123


def fix(input_path, output_path):
    model = flatbuffer_utils.read_model(input_path)
    changed = 0
    for oc in model.operatorCodes:
        if oc.builtinCode == SELECT:
            oc.builtinCode = SELECT_V2
            changed += 1
    flatbuffer_utils.write_model(model, output_path)
    print(f"SELECT -> SELECT_V2: changed {changed} operatorCode(s)")
    print(f"  {input_path} -> {output_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("input")
    p.add_argument("output")
    a = p.parse_args()
    fix(a.input, a.output)

```

# Device O62 Skill

Operate O62/O62LTE hardware for firmware building, flashing, monitoring, and debugging.

## Manifest (machine-readable contract)

> 本段是 device-skill **manifest 契约 v1.0**（机器可读），供 `module-dev` 职能 agent 及其 worker 按 schema 解析。manifest 是**能力声明**，不是命令仓库——完整命令体仍唯一住在本 SKILL.md 命令章节与 `references/`；`invocation` 只放带占位骨架。可选字段缺省 = 该品类无此能力，consumer 跳过对应步骤。
>
> device-o62 ≈ device-p62 穿戴极简形态：inline build（`lunch`+`m`）+ dldtool（**双芯片模式**）通道，**省略** worktree / sil / 品类级 preconditions。`VARIANT` 占位 o62|o62lte（首步须问清）。

```yaml
schema_version: "1.0"
category: device-o62             # == skill 目录名，与注入的 device_skill 名互校验

build:
  carrier: inline                # 命令内联在 SKILL.md「Local Build」章节，无独立 build.md
  command_doc: build             # inline 载体下无 references.build 键，回退读 SKILL.md
  invocation: "source build/envsetup.sh && lunch vendor/bes/boards/best1600_ep/<VARIANT>/configs/<core> && m -j<N>"
                                 # VARIANT=o62|o62lte；cores: ap/cp/sensor/audio/tee/ota/bootloader/bootloader2/recovery
  artifact_glob: "out/bes_<VARIANT>_<core>/vela_*.bin"

flash:
  channels:
    - method: dldtool            # 双芯片：--set-dual-chip 1（Flash0 bl2/tee/ap/audio）/ 0（Flash1 cp）；须在 tmux 内跑
      command_doc: flash         # → flash-commands.md
      invocation: "chmod 666 <flash_port> && ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 <flash_port> <programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin> --set-dual-chip <1|0> [--addr <addr> <bin>]... --no-default-magic --reboot"
      baud: 921600
      transport: usb
  default_channel: dldtool
  partition_model:               # 多分区按地址/双芯片寻址（NOR + eMMC）
    partitions: [bl, tee, ap, cp, audio, sensor, vendor]
    targets:
      nor_all: [tee, ap, audio, cp]   # "flash all WITHOUT bootloader"（安全默认）
      sensor: [sensor]                # eMMC vendor.bin（local 需 gen_emmc_img.sh repack）
    target_rules: flash          # 分区→programmer/地址/dual-chip 映射详见 flash-commands.md
    artifacts:
      bl: bl2.bin
      tee: vela_tee.bin
      ap: vela_ap.bin
      cp: vela_cp.bin
      audio: vela_audio.bin
      sensor: vela_sensor.bin
  default_target: nor_all

references:                      # 角色键→文件名映射；缺某键 = 该能力此品类不存在
  flash: flash-commands.md
  firmware: firmware-structure.md  # CI 包目录布局/镜像选择
  troubleshooting: troubleshooting.md

remote:
  supported: false

# 省略字段（= 能力不存在，consumer 跳过）：build.compilers/ci_invocation / test / worktree / preconditions / references.{sil,review_rules,...}
```

## Workflow Overview

1. **Get Firmware** — Download from CI (JIRA / Corgi) or local build
2. **Flash Firmware** — Use dldtool with dual-chip mode (in tmux)
3. **Flash Resources** — Use dldtool with eMMC programmer
4. **Monitor Serial** — Use minicom for UART console
5. **Debug** — Coredump offline analysis via gdb-start skill

## Skill Integration

| Task | Skill | When to Use |
|------|-------|-------------|
| Interactive sessions | **tmux skill** | Run dldtool / minicom in managed session |
| GDB debugging | **gdb-start skill** | Coredump offline analysis with ELF symbols |
| Get firmware URL | **jira-crash skill** | Retrieve firmware from JIRA issue |
| CI builds | **corgi-vela-ci skill** | Query/download builds from Corgi |

**Critical**: dldtool requires a real TTY (`isatty()` check). ALWAYS use the **tmux skill** to run dldtool. Never run dldtool via direct bash tool calls.

# dldtool Flash Commands Reference

Complete dldtool command reference for O62/O62LTE devices. All commands sourced from the official flashing guide.

> **Prerequisite**: All dldtool commands require a real TTY and must run inside a tmux session. Create one first: `tmux new-session -s flash-o62`

## Two Programmers

O62 uses two different programmer binaries depending on the target:

| Programmer | Target | Path |
|-----------|--------|------|
| NOR programmer | Flash 0/1 (bl, bl2, tee, ap, audio, cp) | `./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin` |

| Partition | Address Range | Size |
|-----------|--------------|------|
| bootloader | 0x2c000000 - 0x2c040000 | 256KB |
| bootloader2 | 0x2c040000 - 0x2c0c0000 | 512KB |
| tee | 0x2c0c0000 - 0x2c1c0000 | 1MB |
| ap | 0x2c1c0000 - 0x2cc8E000 | 10MB + 824KB |

| reserve | 0x2cffe000 - 0x2d000000 | 8KB |

### Flash 1

| Partition | Address Range | Size |
|-----------|--------------|------|
| cp | 0x34000000 - 0x343BF000 | 3836KB |
| misc | 0x343BF000 - 0x343FF000 | 256KB (littlefs, factory calibration) |
| factory | 0x343FF000 - 0x34400000 | 4KB (bes reserved) |

| Partition | Start Block | Size | Content |

| vendor | 37 | 50MB | Dynamic loaded firmware (includes vela_sensor.bin) |

| app | 409637 | 300MB | Application resources |
| misc | 1024037 | 100MB | Audio resources, reserved for new app resources |

| font | 1331237 | 50MB | Fonts |

| store | 2355234 | 50MB | Store demo resources |
| nv | 2457634 | 10MB | Modem NV |

# NuttX File Transfer — Method Selection

## Decision Table

| Scenario | Method | Constraint |
|----------|--------|------------|
| Serial console connected, physical device | **Ymodem** | `CONFIG_SYSTEM_YMODEM`, needs `rb`/`sb` |
| USB cable connected, development workflow | **ADB** | `CONFIG_SYSTEM_ADBD` + `CONFIG_ADBD_FILE_SERVICE` |
| QEMU simulation, share host directory | **9pfs** | `CONFIG_FS_V9FS` + `CONFIG_V9FS_VIRTIO_9P` |
| QEMU simulation, TCP network available | **9pfs socket** | `CONFIG_FS_V9FS` + `CONFIG_V9FS_SOCKET_9P` |

## Selection Logic

When multiple methods are available, choose by priority:

1. **QEMU environment** → use 9pfs (virtio if host directory sharing is possible, socket if only TCP)
2. **USB cable connected** → prefer ADB (`ADBD_FILE_SERVICE=y`) — faster and more reliable than Ymodem
3. **Serial console only** → use Ymodem

40	def quantize_weight_axis(model, sg, tensor_idx, axis):
41	    """per-channel int8 量化单个权重张量, axis 指定 per-channel 维度。"""
42	    t = sg.tensors[tensor_idx]
43	    buf = model.buffers[t.buffer]
44	    if buf.data is None or len(buf.data) == 0:
45	        return False
46	    w = np.frombuffer(bytes(buf.data), dtype=np.float32).reshape(t.shape)
47	
48	    if axis < 0:

50	    n_chan = w.shape[axis]
51	    # 把 axis 移到 0 方便遍历
52	    w_m = np.moveaxis(w, axis, 0)  # [n_chan, ...]
53	    flat = w_m.reshape(n_chan, -1)
54	
55	    scales = np.zeros(n_chan, dtype=np.float32)
56	    w_q = np.zeros_like(w_m, dtype=np.int8)

59	        scales[i] = abs_max / 127.0 if abs_max > 0 else 1.0
60	        if abs_max > 0:
61	            w_q[i] = np.clip(np.round(w_m[i] / scales[i]), -127, 127).astype(np.int8)
62	    # 移回原轴序
63	    w_q = np.moveaxis(w_q, 0, axis)
64	
65	    buf.data = list(w_q.tobytes())
66	    t.type = 9  # INT8
67	    q = schema.QuantizationParametersT()
68	    q.scale = scales.tolist()
69	    q.zeroPoint = [0] * n_chan
70	    q.quantizedDimension = axis
71	    t.quantization = q
72	    return True

# Ymodem Reference

Serial file transfer. Host tool: `./apps/system/ymodem/sbrb.py` (relative to workspace root, i.e. cwd — do NOT search with `find`). Device commands: `rb` (receive) / `sb` (send).

## Block Size Modes

| Flag | Packet Type | Header | Use When |
|------|-------------|--------|----------|
| (none) | 128 bytes | SOH `0x01` | **Default, preferred** — most stable, use unless speed is critical |
| `-k` | 1024 bytes | STX `0x02` | Faster, but less stable than 128-byte |
| `-k N` | N×1024 bytes | STC `0x03` | Extended protocol, fastest (~93% baud at `-k 32`), least stable |

## Hard Rules

1. Check baud rate and serial port before running `sbrb.py` — wrong port or baud will cause silent failure or garbled data.
2. Serial port must be at `nsh>` prompt before running `sbrb.py` — it auto-sends `rb`/`sb` to the device
3. `-r` (recvfrom) triggers `sb <files>` on device; `-s <path>` (sendto) triggers `rb -f <path>` on device
4. `-k` without value = 1 (1K standard); `-k 0` = no `-k` (128 bytes)
5. `-c N` mode waits for N consecutive `C` bytes — use when device initiates transfer (no `rb` command needed)
6. **Close minicom / screen / picocom before running `sbrb.py -t`** — any process holding the serial port (including root processes) will cause the transfer to fail silently or with garbled data
7. Both sides must use the same `-k N` value for extended protocol
8. Use `-q` (quiet mode) in automation — prints only at 10% milestones, avoids flooding logs
9. Ctrl+C (SIGINT) or `timeout` expiry (SIGTERM) both send two CAN bytes to the remote end before exiting — remote receiver will abort cleanly

## Patterns

**Send file to board (host → device)**

```bash
# 128-byte mode (default, preferred)
python3 sbrb.py -q -t /dev/ttyUSB0 -b 921600 -s /tmp file.bin
python3 sbrb.py -q -t /dev/ttyACM0 -b 921600 -s /tmp file.bin

# Standard 1K mode
python3 sbrb.py -q -t /dev/ttyUSB0 -b 921600 -s /tmp -k file.bin

# Extended 32K mode (fastest, ~93% baud efficiency)
python3 sbrb.py -q -t /dev/ttyUSB0 -b 921600 -s /tmp -k 32 file.bin

# Quiet mode (milestone-only progress: 10%, 20%, ... 100%)
python3 sbrb.py -q -t /dev/ttyUSB0 -b 921600 -s /tmp -q file.bin
```

**Receive file from board (device → host)**

```bash
python3 sbrb.py -q -t /dev/ttyUSB0 -b 921600 -r /data/log.txt
```

**Automation — wait for device to initiate**

```bash
python3 sbrb.py -q -t /dev/ttyUSB0 -b 921600 -c 3 -w 30 file.bin
```

## Kconfig

```
CONFIG_SYSTEM_YMODEM=y
CONFIG_SYSTEM_YMODEM_DEBUG=y                        # optional
CONFIG_SYSTEM_YMODEM_DEBUG_FILEPATH="/tmp/ymodem"   # optional
```

## Anti-Patterns

| Mistake | Consequence | Fix |
|---------|-------------|-----|
| minicom open while running `sbrb.py -t` | garbled data or silent failure — even if minicom runs as root | Check with `lsof /dev/ttyUSB0` or `fuser /dev/ttyUSB0` first, then close minicom/screen/picocom |
| Host `-k N` ≠ device `-k N` | Protocol mismatch, transfer fails | Use same N on both sides |
| High baud on noisy cable | CRC errors, retries, timeout | Lower baud or use 128-byte mode |
| `-k 0` expecting 1K mode | Gets 128-byte mode | Use `-k` (no value) for 1K |

        n=s.read(4096)
        if n: data+=n
    return data.decode('utf-8','replace')

        print(f"### {c}")
        print('\n'.join(lines[-12:]))
        print()
    s.close()
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR:",e)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Single-process Ymodem push to O62 /data over a persistent serial fd,
# surviving the sensor-core "[sen] get_cur_batty_info" log spam by using a
# huge receiver retry budget (rb -r 1000000) and a huge sender maxretry.
import sys, time, serial, os
YMD = '/home/zhangyi101/project26/vela-miwear-bes-o62-25rc05-tflm/apps/system/ymodem'
sys.path.insert(0, YMD)
import sbrb  # noqa: E402

PORT = '/dev/ttyACM1'
BAUD = 921600
MAXRETRY = 100000

def send_one(filepath):
    fd = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.5)
    sbrb.fd_serial = fd
    time.sleep(0.3)
    fd.reset_input_buffer()

    # 1. enter /data
    fd.write(b'cd /data\r\n')
    time.sleep(0.6)
    _drain(fd, "cd")

    # 2. start receiver with enormous retry budget (spam won't cancel it)
    fd.write(b'rb -r %d -f /data\r\n' % MAXRETRY)
    time.sleep(1.0)
    _drain(fd, "rb-start")

    # 3. drive the Ymodem send on the same fd
    ym = sbrb.ymodem(customsize=0,
                     read=sbrb.ymodem_ser_read,
                     write=sbrb.ymodem_ser_write,
                     clear=sbrb.ymodem_ser_clear,
                     maxretry=MAXRETRY)
    print("=== sending %s (%d B) ===" % (os.path.basename(filepath),
                                        os.path.getsize(filepath)), flush=True)
    ret = ym.send([filepath])
    print("=== send returned:", ret, flush=True)

    # nudge NSH back to prompt
    fd.write(b'\n')
    time.sleep(0.3)
    _drain(fd, "post")
    fd.close()
    return ret

def _drain(fd, tag):
    data = fd.read(8192)
    if data:
        txt = data.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
        # show last bit, spam-stripped
        lines = [l for l in txt.splitlines() if 'get_cur_batty_info' not in l]
        tail = ' | '.join(lines[-3:]) if lines else '(only spam)'
        print("[%s] %s" % (tag, tail[-160:]))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    files = sys.argv[1:]
    for f in files:
        send_one(f)
        print("---", flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Debug NSH -> rb startup: confirm prompt, confirm rb emits 'C' invites.
import serial, time

PORT='/dev/ttyACM1'; BAUD=921600
fd=serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.2)
time.sleep(0.3); fd.reset_input_buffer()

def readfor(sec):
    end=time.time()+sec; data=b''
    while time.time()<end:
        n=fd.read(4096)
        if n: data+=n
    return data

# 1. get to prompt
fd.write(b'\n\n'); time.sleep(0.2)
d=readfor(2.0)
txt=d.decode('utf-8','replace')
nsp=[l for l in txt.splitlines() if 'get_cur_batty_info' not in l and l.strip()]
print("[prompt-probe] non-spam lines:", nsp[-6:])
print("[prompt-probe] has ap>:", 'ap>' in txt)

# 2. cd /data
fd.reset_input_buffer()
fd.write(b'cd /data\r\n'); time.sleep(0.3)
d=readfor(1.5); txt=d.decode('utf-8','replace')
nsp=[l for l in txt.splitlines() if 'get_cur_batty_info' not in l and l.strip()]
print("[cd /data] non-spam:", nsp[-4:])

# 3. start rb, look for 'C' (0x43) invites
fd.reset_input_buffer()
fd.write(b'rb -r 1000000 -f /data\r\n'); time.sleep(0.3)
d=readfor(3.0)
# count 'C' invite bytes (0x43) that are standalone (not inside spam text)
txt=d.decode('utf-8','replace')
nsp=[l for l in txt.splitlines() if 'get_cur_batty_info' not in l and l.strip()]
print("[rb-start] non-spam lines:", nsp[-4:])
# raw byte scan for 0x43 not part of ascii text — just count 0x43 occurrences in raw
c_count=d.count(b'\x43')
print("[rb-start] raw 0x43 count in %d bytes: %d" % (len(d), c_count))
print("[rb-start] raw tail hex:", d[-40:].hex())

fd.write(b'\x18\x18')  # CAN CAN to abort rb if running
time.sleep(0.3); readfor(0.5)
fd.write(b'\n'); time.sleep(0.2); readfor(0.5)
fd.close()

    arr=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype=dt)

import sys, os, time
sys.path.insert(0, '.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages')
import numpy as np
import ai_edge_litert.interpreter as litert

PCM='PTQ_silero_vad/silero_vad_input.pcm'
MODELS=['PTQ_silero_vad/models/silero_vad_hybrid.tflite',
        'PTQ_silero_vad/models/silero_vad_hybrid_folded.tflite']

raw=open(PCM,'rb').read()
pcm=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype=np.int16)
print("pcm samples:", len(pcm), "(%d chunks of 512)"%(len(pcm)//512))

def run(path):
    interp=litert.Interpreter(model_path=path, num_threads=1)
    interp.allocate_tensors()
    ind={t['name']:t for t in interp.get_input_details()}
    outd=interp.get_output_details()
    # locate by numel
    def numel(t):
        n=1
        for d in t['shape']: n*=int(d)
        return n
    audio_in=state_in=None
    for t in interp.get_input_details():
        if numel(t)==576: audio_in=t
        elif numel(t)==256: state_in=t
    prob_out=state_out=None
    for t in outd:
        if numel(t)==1: prob_out=t
        elif numel(t)==256: state_out=t
    assert audio_in and state_in and prob_out and state_out, (audio_in,state_in,prob_out,state_out)
    state=np.zeros(state_in['shape'],dtype=np.float32)
    context=np.zeros(64,dtype=np.float32)
    n_chunks=len(pcm)//512
    probs=np.zeros(n_chunks,dtype=np.float32)
    for c in range(n_chunks):
        chunk=pcm[c*512:(c+1)*512].astype(np.float32)/32768.0
        audio=np.concatenate([context,chunk])  # 64+512=576
        context=chunk[512-64:].copy()
        interp.set_tensor(audio_in['index'], audio.reshape(audio_in['shape']).astype(np.float32))
        interp.set_tensor(state_in['index'], state)
        interp.invoke()
        p=interp.get_tensor(prob_out['index'])
        s=interp.get_tensor(state_out['index'])
        probs[c]=float(p.reshape(-1)[0])
        state=s.reshape(state.shape).astype(np.float32).copy()
    return probs

P={}
for mp in MODELS:
    t0=time.time()
    try:
        P[mp]=run(mp)
        print("%-55s ok  n=%d  %.2fs  first5=%s  sum=%.4f" % (os.path.basename(mp), len(P[mp]), time.time()-t0, P[mp][:5].round(4), P[mp].sum()))
    except Exception as e:
        print("%-55s FAILED: %r" % (os.path.basename(mp), e))
        P[mp]=None

# compare
a=MODELS[0]; b=MODELS[1]
if P[a] is not None and P[b] is not None:
    d=np.abs(P[a]-P[b])
    print("\n=== orig vs folded ===")
    print("max abs diff = %.3e   mean = %.3e   n_equal(1e-6)=%d/%d" % (d.max(), d.mean(), (d<1e-6).sum(), len(d)))
    # segmentation (thr 0.5/0.35, min speech 8, min silence 3, pad1) — quick segment count
    def segs(probs, on=0.5, off=0.35, minsp=8, minsi=3):
        issp=probs>=on; isoff=probs<off
        # state machine
        active=False; segs=[]; start=0; silence=0
        for i,p in enumerate(probs):
            if not active:
                if p>=on: active=True; start=i; silence=0
            else:
                if p<off:
                    silence+=1
                    if silence>=minsi:
                        if i-silence-start>=minsp: segs.append((start,i-silence))
                        active=False; silence=0
                else: silence=0
        if active and len(probs)-start>=minsp: segs.append((start,len(probs)))
        return segs
    for mp in [a,b]:
        print("%s segments=%d" % (os.path.basename(mp), len(segs(P[mp]))))

## Root Cause (mechanism)

When `speed_test_cmd` times out (2s sem_timedwait), it calls `l2cap_trans_reset()`
from the bttool main task, which does `memset(&g_trans_ctx, 0, ...)`. However,
the bttool-l2cap worker thread's `bulk_trans_complete` callback is still active
(pending write completions).

After memset zeroes `g_trans_ctx`:
1. `bulk_count` becomes 0.
2. Next write completion fires: `ctx->bulk_count--` → underflows to -1.
3. Check `if (ctx->bulk_count)` → -1 != 0 → always true.
4. `euv_pipe_write(handle, buf, ctx->bulk_length=0, ...)` — 0-byte write
   completes immediately without IO, re-invoking the callback.
5. Tight infinite loop: bttool-l2cap (PRI 101) at 100% CPU.
6. Main task (PRI 100) cannot be scheduled → serial unresponsive.
7. ~4 minutes later → watchdog crash.

Root issue: cross-thread `memset` of shared state without synchronization,
causing integer underflow in the callback loop condition.

## Symptoms

- Serial console becomes unresponsive after running L2CAP speed test twice.
- System hangs for ~4 minutes then watchdog asserts.
- `dump_task` shows: `bttool-l2cap_241 PRI 101 Running CPU 99.8%`.

## Fix Pattern

On CMD_ERROR return from `speed_test_cmd`, signal the worker thread to exit
its loop (or add a blocking wait/yield on the error path).

# dldtool Flash Commands Reference

Complete dldtool command reference for O62/O62LTE devices. All commands sourced from the official flashing guide.

> **Prerequisite**: All dldtool commands require a real TTY and must run inside a tmux session. Create one first: `tmux new-session -s flash-o62`

O62 uses two different programmer binaries depending on the target:

| Programmer | Target | Path |
|-----------|--------|------|
| NOR programmer | Flash 0/1 (bl, bl2, tee, ap, audio, cp) | `./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin` |
